issues.what: Terms promise a two-bedroom house, but chapters 2-3 have three rooms (Tamoya's, Kimone's, the spare room)
issues.quote: Residence: my blue house, two bedrooms. Tamoya gets bedroom one. You get spare room.

issues.what: 2am gate-squeak cliffhanger is dropped, then repeated as new at the end of ch4
issues.quote: At two in the morning the front gate squeaked again in the wind

issues.what: The 'laminated house terms' list contradicts ch1 TERMS and ch2 house rules; 'term nine' has no source
issues.quote: the laminated list of house terms she had typed in week one

issues.what: Duplicate chapter title (ch2 'The Friday Wedding'); no wedding in this chapter
issues.quote: Friday Wedding

issues.what: Goat raffle note says school fees; Kimone and ch4 say building fund
issues.quote: FOR TAMOYA SCHOOL FEES RAFFLE

issues.what: Real brand name (Milo) repeated in ch4 and ch5
issues.quote: collecting tickets into a Milo tin

issues.what: Repeated openers and phrases: rain-held-off opener echoes ch2; stomach dropping echoes ch3
issues.quote: Kimone felt her stomach drop straight through her shoes.

issues.what: Plan-like meta phrasing and a garbled phrase
issues.quote: on a Tuesday in Week 3 / For twelve years old to now

issues.what: Jamaica's courts are now Parish Courts with parish judges, not magistrates; odd closing image; missing apostrophes (maam, o clock)
issues.quote: under the mango dark sky

fix: Ch1: make the house 'a spare room' not 'two bedrooms'. Ch3: replace the 2am gate cliffhanger, fix 'Week 3' and 'For twelve'. Ch4: retitle, new opener, tie the list to the ch1 TERMS plus amendments (incl. term nine), remove Milo, fix ma'am/o'clock. Ch5: retitle, building-fund note, make the repeat bed question deliberate, judge not magistrate, fix last line.
praise: Tamoya putting them in the same bed 'for the story' and Delroy's plain truthful court answer: real comedy, real heart, and patois used lightly and with respect.

issues.what: The bequest is 42,000 euros; the brief says sixty thousand (ch1 twice, ch3)
issues.quote: the sum of forty two thousand euros

issues.what: Maurice refused in ch1 to say what Fons played until after the burial, then tells them freely; Fons's instrument drifts between cornet and bugle
issues.quote: Bugle, mostly. Third row.

issues.what: Fons is a bachelor in ch1 but is buried beside 'his wife'
issues.quote: They buried him between his wife and an empty plot

issues.what: The score is Fons's handwriting, not Maurice's
issues.quote: because Maurice's handwriting leaned like poplars in wind

issues.what: Jeroen and Stef push the bier while also playing cornet and euphonium
issues.quote: Jeroen and Stef lifted the wheeled bier.

issues.what: Ch2 title 'The 1951 Photo' names a discovery from ch1; ch3 title contradicts the march being played
issues.quote: The 1951 Photo

issues.what: French 'Madame' from a Flemish teenager; garbled photo caption
issues.quote: Last name: Fons Verhaeghe, bugel.

fix: Money becomes sixty thousand in ch1 and ch3. Instrument is cornet everywhere; Maurice only confirms it in ch2 because the attic photo already gave it away. Ch3: parents, not wife; other people push the bier. Retitle ch2 and ch3. Fix the handwriting and caption slips.
praise: Deadpan and warm: the drum 'like someone patting a melon', the backwards repeat everyone takes together, and article nine's apology 'to the band, which is not' dead.

issues.what: Garbled sentence at Dot's first line
issues.quote: she called through her tin whistle string bouncing.

issues.what: The mayor retells the fright plan the reader just saw, to nobody in particular
issues.quote: Tell them what happened, Fennimore.

issues.what: A drum lands on the mayor's head (brief: nobody hurt)
issues.quote: The drum landed on his head. Bong.

issues.what: 'Someone new' turns out to be Old Tibb, whom Dot already knows
issues.quote: Someone new was coming up the garden path

issues.what: Loaves bounce into the sea again as though for the first time
issues.quote: My loaves! My Harvest Day loaves!

issues.what: The mayor's fear of heights from the brief never shows up

fix: Ch1: fix Dot's line, drum lands in his lap, 'someone' not 'someone new'. Ch2: name the diaphragm (a true fact). Ch3: cut the mayor's recap, make the loaves a running gag, add a line about the mayor's fear of heights.
praise: A tortoise who apologises after every hic, and a cure (slow breathing to a tin whistle) that is true, kind and makes a lovely ending to read aloud.
